_comment: Missions are data. Every feature in a test plays one role. target: w = default weight (0-100), dir = match | high | low (used in Stress mode; Realism mode always matches). interference: the site must stay on the right side of v; hard = strict pass/fail, soft = penalty plus warning. Features not listed are ignored for this test. 'baseline' = precedent field sites (analogs.json). 'lab' = what to pair the field test with.

systems.label: Lunar Terrain Vehicle
systems.blurb: Unpressurised crew rover for the south pole (and its Mars cousins).

tests.label: Wheel traction & suspension
tests.question: Where can wheels meet the same slopes, bumps and rocks they will meet at the target?

slope_deg.why: Grade sets the torque the wheels must deliver and the tip-over margin.

rough_m.why: Bumps excite the suspension; too smooth hides failure modes.

rock_pct.why: Rocks above wheel height are the main mobility hazard.

soil_kPa.why: Soft ground means sinkage and slip.

snow_mo.why: Needs a snow-free field season of at least three months; schedule the campaign inside it.

ndvi.why: Roots and plants bind the soil and hide obstacles.

precip_mm.why: Wet soil is cohesive; lunar soil is bone dry.

ignore.t_mean_C: Air temperature does not change traction.
ignore.dust_ug: Airborne dust is a separate dust test.

tests.lab: Pair with reduced-gravity traction runs in a regolith bin (e.g. NASA Glenn SLOPE lab) with offloaded wheel loads.

tests.label: Navigation cameras & lidar
tests.question: Where do long shadows and rough ground challenge stereo cameras and lidar the way the pole will?

low_sun_pct.why: Grazing light makes deep shadows that hide hazards from cameras.

rough_m.why: Relief creates occlusions and false obstacles.

slope_deg.why: Slopes change the camera's view of the horizon.

dark_d.why: Driving through darkness relies on lidar and headlights.

ndvi.why: Plants move in wind and confuse stereo matching.

snow_mo.why: Long snow seasons shorten the usable field window and flatten contrast.

dust_ug.why: Airborne haze scatters lidar; the Moon has none.

ignore.t_mean_C: Sensors are tested at ambient temperature here.
ignore.basalt: Rock type barely changes optical navigation.

tests.lab: Pair with a collimated low-angle lighting bay to remove Earth's sky fill-light.

tests.label: Remote driving & radio links
tests.question: Where does terrain break line-of-sight the way crater rims and ridges will?

rough_m.why: Ridges and pits block line-of-sight radio.

slope_deg.why: Steep relief creates shadow zones behind hills.

remote_km.why: Few towns means a quiet radio spectrum and no cell towers to lean on.

ndvi.why: Foliage absorbs radio signals in ways regolith does not.

ignore.t_mean_C: Not a driver for link margin.
ignore.precip_mm: Rain fade matters only at high frequencies.

tests.lab: Inject 2.6 s Earth–Moon round-trip delay in the ground segment during the field test.

tests.label: Thermal control & batteries
tests.question: Where are day–night swings and cold closest to the target, without liquid water?

lst_dtr_K.why: Each swing is one thermal cycle on seals, joints and cells.

t_mean_C.why: Cold soaks drain batteries and stiffen lubricants.

t_range_K.why: Seasonal extremes widen the cycle envelope.

precip_mm.why: Liquid water freeze–thaw is a failure mode the Moon never sees.

snow_mo.why: Snow insulates hardware and blunts the cycle.

ignore.slope_deg: Terrain does not matter for a parked thermal test.

tests.lab: Pair with a thermal-vacuum chamber: in air, convection carries heat away that vacuum would not.

tests.label: Dust seals & bearings
tests.question: Where is abrasive, angular, dry dust most abundant?

dust_ug.why: More dust means more grit reaching seals.

basalt.why: Basaltic fines are angular and glassy like the target's regolith.

rough_m.why: Rough driving pumps dust into joints.

precip_mm.why: Moisture clumps dust and stops it migrating.

ndvi.why: Plant cover keeps dust on the ground.

ignore.t_mean_C: Wear does not depend on air temperature here.

tests.lab: Pair with a dust chamber using LHS-1 simulant and UV charging.

systems.label: Spacesuits & EVA
systems.blurb: Exploration suits (AxEMU), boots, lights and the crew who wear them.

tests.label: Boots & lower body
tests.question: Where will boots meet the same grades, bumps and rocks as the traverse?

slope_deg.why: Walking grade drives knee and ankle loads in the suit.

rough_m.why: Uneven ground tests stability and boot sole grip.

rock_pct.why: Rock fields set trip hazards and route choice.

snow_mo.why: Needs a snow-free field season of at least three months; schedule the campaign inside it.

ndvi.why: Vegetation softens and hides the ground.

precip_mm.why: Mud and wet rock are slippery in a way regolith is not.

ignore.lst_dtr_K: Suit thermal is tested in chambers.

tests.lab: Pair with partial-gravity walking on NASA JSC's ARGOS offload rig.

tests.label: Helmet lights & low-sun vision
tests.question: Where do crews work in grazing light and long darkness?

low_sun_pct.why: Low sun creates blinding glare and black shadows.

dark_d.why: Long darkness means working by helmet light.

rough_m.why: Relief casts the long shadows lights must fill.

ndvi.why: Vegetation changes surface brightness and texture.

ignore.basalt: Albedo matters more than rock type; not yet measured.

tests.lab: Pair with a black-walled lighting bay: Earth's blue sky fills shadows the Moon leaves black.

tests.label: Suit dust protection
tests.question: Where will suits collect the most angular, dry dust?

dust_ug.why: Dust loading drives abrasion of bearings and visors.

basalt.why: Basaltic fines are the closest Earth analog to regolith.

rough_m.why: Kneeling and sampling on rough ground kicks up more dust.

precip_mm.why: Damp dust sticks rather than migrates.

ignore.low_sun_pct: Light is not a dust driver.

tests.lab: Pair with a dust chamber; lunar dust clings electrostatically in vacuum.

tests.label: Crew operations & isolation
tests.question: Where can a crew live and work far from help, in cold and darkness?

remote_km.why: Isolation forces self-reliance and real procedures.

t_mean_C.why: Cold adds workload and constrains EVA time.

dark_d.why: Odd light cycles disrupt sleep like the lunar day does.

slope_deg.why: Traverse terrain shapes daily EVA planning.

ignore.basalt: Geology is not the point of a crew test.

tests.lab: Pair with closed habitats (NASA HERA, CHAPEA) for long-duration isolation.

systems.label: Resource extraction (ISRU)
systems.blurb: Digging, drilling, filtering and cleaning what the ground provides.

tests.label: Air-intake filters
tests.question: Where is the air dustiest, thinnest and coldest, so filters clog the way they would on Mars?

dust_ug.why: Dust loading sets how fast filters clog.

pressure_kPa.why: Thin air changes flow and pressure drop across filters.

t_mean_C.why: Cold air is denser and stiffens filter media.

precip_mm.why: Humidity makes dust cake on filters in an un-Martian way.

ndvi.why: Pollen and organic aerosols contaminate the test.

ignore.slope_deg: Terrain is irrelevant to a static intake.

tests.lab: Pair with a 0.6 kPa CO₂ chamber: no Earth site comes within 80× of Mars pressure.

tests.label: Ice excavation
tests.question: Where is ice-cemented ground shallow, cold and dry at the surface?

ice_m.why: Depth to ice sets how much overburden must be moved.

t_mean_C.why: Only cold ground keeps ice cemented year-round.

rough_m.why: Surface relief changes access and spoil handling.

precip_mm.why: Surface meltwater makes mud, not ice-cemented regolith.

ndvi.why: Vegetated permafrost has an organic layer Mars lacks.

tests.lab: Pair with cold-room bins of ice-regolith simulant at −60 °C.

tests.label: Ice & rock drills
tests.question: Where is the ground coldest and hardest, with ice and target-like rock?

t_mean_C.why: Cold changes ice hardness and bit cooling.

ice_m.why: Ice at depth is the drilling target.

basalt.why: Bit wear depends on rock type.

t_range_K.why: Thermal stress on the drill string.

tests.lab: Pair with a cryo-vacuum drill chamber: ice sublimates at 0.6 kPa.

tests.label: Water cleanup
tests.question: Where do soils carry the salts and oxidants Mars water will contain?

salt_pct.why: Perchlorate and salts are what cleanup must remove.

precip_mm.why: Only hyper-arid ground keeps salts in the soil.

ignore.slope_deg: Terrain is irrelevant to a process plant.

tests.lab: Pair with spiked simulant runs (MGS-1 + perchlorate).

tests.label: Regolith excavation & processing
tests.question: Where is loose, dry, target-like rock easy to dig and process?

basalt.why: Feedstock chemistry: mare basalt or highland anorthosite.

dust_ug.why: Fines drive wear on processing hardware.

precip_mm.why: Wet feedstock behaves nothing like regolith.

snow_mo.why: Needs a snow-free field season of at least three months; schedule the campaign inside it.

tests.lab: Pair with simulant bins (LHS-1 highland, LMS-1 mare) in vacuum.

systems.label: Habitats & power
systems.blurb: Shelter, foundations and the power that keeps the base alive.

tests.label: Habitat thermal cycling
tests.question: Where will a habitat shell see the largest, coldest cycles without rain?

lst_dtr_K.why: Daily cycling fatigues joints, seals and coatings.

t_mean_C.why: Cold sets heater power and insulation needs.

precip_mm.why: Rain and freeze–thaw add failures that space never causes.

snow_mo.why: Snow loads and insulation distort the test.

ignore.basalt: Rock type does not affect shell temperatures.

tests.lab: Pair with thermal-vacuum cycling of shell coupons.

tests.label: Foundations & ground stability
tests.question: Where is flat, firm, dry ground like a base site?

slope_deg.why: Level ground limits leveling work and tipping risk.

snow_mo.why: Long snow seasons shorten the usable field window and flatten contrast.

tests.lab: Pair with plate-load tests in compacted simulant.

tests.label: Solar arrays & night survival
tests.question: Where is sunlight low and darkness long, like the polar day–night cycle?

low_sun_pct.why: Vertical arrays must track a Sun skimming the horizon.

precip_mm.why: Cloudy, wet climates cut irradiance unpredictably.

tests.lab: Pair with a solar simulator; a 14-day lunar night cannot be reproduced outdoors.

tests.label: Fission surface power siting
tests.question: Where is there flat, stable ground, far from people, for a reactor pad and berms?

slope_deg.why: A level pad for the reactor and radiators.

remote_km.why: Exclusion distance from the crew habitat.

precip_mm.why: Rain cools radiators in ways vacuum never will.

tests.lab: No field precedent yet: pair with DOE/NASA ground tests in the style of KRUSTY.

systems.label: Science instruments
systems.blurb: Spectrometers and sampling tools for geology and life detection.

tests.label: Mineral ID spectrometers
tests.question: Where is bare rock of the right type exposed to the sky?

basalt.why: Spectra must see the same mineral families.

rough_m.why: Outcrops need relief to be exposed.

tests.lab: Pair with EMIT-vs-CRISM spectral matching once the mineral layer is added.

tests.label: Astrobiology sampling
tests.question: Where is the ground so dry and cold that life is barely detectable?

precip_mm.why: Hyper-aridity pushes life to its detection limit.

t_mean_C.why: Cold slows biology and preserves biomarkers.

salt_pct.why: Salts and oxidants degrade organics like on Mars.

ignore.slope_deg: Terrain does not matter for sampling.

tests.lab: Pair with sterile-sample handling and UV-irradiated controls.

systems.label: Landers
systems.blurb: Landing sensors and the ground they must judge from above.

tests.label: Landing hazard detection
tests.question: Where can landing sensors practise spotting slopes, rocks and craters like those at the landing zone?

slope_deg.why: Hazard detection must classify slopes near the lander's tip-over limit.

rough_m.why: Relief and crater rims are what the sensor maps from altitude.

rock_pct.why: Boulders above the leg clearance are the main touchdown hazard.

low_sun_pct.why: Grazing light hides hazards in shadow from camera-based sensors.

ndvi.why: Vegetation hides the ground from lidar and cameras.

snow_mo.why: Needs a snow-free season: snow erases rocks and shadows.

ignore.t_mean_C: Sensor thermal is tested in chambers.
ignore.precip_mm: Not a driver for a flight test window.

tests.lab: Pair with helicopter or drone sensor flights and plume–surface interaction tests in vacuum.
